capabilities: Parse pasted calls into structured notes with deadlines, amounts, eligibility and materials
Track application status changes with a dated timeline and a due-soon board
Check the materials folder against required documents
Screen eligibility against a profile using rules and an optional local model
extras: Free, open source under MIT, no accounts, API keys or telemetry; all model features are optional and the regex-based parsing, board, materials check and letter drafts work without Ollama.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage grant and fellowship applications: extracting deadlines and requirements from calls, tracking outstanding recommendation letters and materials, and screening one's own eligibility across many opportunities.

relations.evidence: run an eligibility screen of the call's criteria against your profile with a local model (via Ollama)

summary: Fellowship application tracker that turns pasted calls into structured notes, tracks deadlines and letters, checks materials and screens eligibility.
